 HAMILTON, New Zealand (AP) — Rain has delayed the start of the third one-day cricket international between New Zealand and India Tuesday at Seddon Park.
 The toss, which was set to be made at 2.30 p.m. local time, has been rescheduled for 4.30 p.m. but further rain is forecast.
 Rain also affected the first match of the series in Auckland which India won by five wickets and the second in Wellington, which India won by four runs to take a 2-0 series lead. Both matches were decided under the Duckworth Lewis system.
